units.source_text: 思绪翩跹的时候，连谐谑的气氛也袭击了我。

en.t: When my thoughts were fluttering about, even a mood of mockery came over me.
"If I were to burn down the Golden Pavilion..."

units.source_text: "这种行为可能会有明显的教育效果吧。

en.t: "Such an act might have a clear educational effect.

units.source_text: 因为人们会以此类推，从而学习到不灭是没有任何意义的。

en.t: For people would reason from it and learn that being indestructible has no meaning at all.

units.source_text: 学习到金阁单单持续五百五十年耸立在镜湖池畔是不会成为任何事物的保证的。

en.t: They would learn that the Golden Pavilion's merely standing for five hundred and fifty years beside Kyoko Pond guarantees nothing whatsoever.

units.source_text: 还学习到我们的生存骑在其上的当然前提就是一种不安——明天也会崩溃的不安。"

en.t: And they would also learn that the natural premise on which our existence rests is a kind of unease: the unease that it too may collapse tomorrow."
